title: ACP 2.0 ResearchRecord (minimal reference v1)
description: Minimal reference ResearchRecord contract frozen by T-03 / C01b. A ResearchRecord is the persisted scientific/provenance evidence for one research round: the plan definition it evaluated, the materialized step identities, the platform TaskRefs that actually executed, the evidence references and the missing validations. It is NOT a DSH chat/session transcript: session_id, chat_id, messages, transcript or model-role fields are rejected by the schema's `not` clause. A chat session may propose text, but only this record (written by the owning service) is evidence. TaskRefs carry job_id/attempt/release_id plus project_id so cross-project leakage is detectable; the project must equal the containing record's project_id.
$comment: Executable vocabulary is JSON Schema 2020-12 only. range/nullable exist solely inside ui_dialect as non-executable UI annotations with a written standard equivalent. record_revision is optimistic concurrency for the record, not a task attempt.

range.scope: UI annotation only; a generic 2020-12 validator must not execute it

nullable.scope: UI annotation only; a generic 2020-12 validator must not execute it

ui_dialect.rule: Only supported_keywords are executable. range/nullable must never appear outside this ui_dialect block.

research_id.description: Stable research identity within the project.

project_id.description: Project scope. Every task_ref.project_id must equal this value; a mismatch is rejected before any evidence is consumed.

round.description: Research round index. Not a task attempt and not a job lifecycle state.

decision.description: Research decision for this round. Deliberately disjoint from task/job status enums.

plan_definition_digest.description: The exact plan_definition_digest from the proposal this round evaluated. A mismatch against the referenced proposal is a stale reference and must be rejected.

step_identity_refs.description: Step identities materialized before dispatch. Each identity covers actual upstream byte digests, materialized parameters and implementation version.

task_refs.description: Platform TaskRefs that actually executed. A bare string array is not a TaskRef list and is rejected.

missing_validation.description: Validations that were not performed or not satisfied. A blocking entry keeps the round from being treated as complete.

approval_ref.description: Approval that bound this plan_definition_digest + project + budget + allowed_change_scope. Null only for a record that never dispatched.

record_revision.description: Optimistic concurrency revision of this record. A stale revision must not overwrite a newer record.

not.description: A DSH chat/session is not a ResearchRecord. Session/chat/transcript fields are rejected; only the persisted record is evidence.

step_identity.description: Resolved cache/adoption identity for this step, materialized before dispatch.

implementation_version.description: Exact implementation/release version that produced the step identity.

upstream_digests.description: Actual upstream artifact byte digests consumed by the step.

materialized_parameters_digest.description: Digest of the fully materialized parameters (no unresolved defaults).

project_id.description: Must equal the containing ResearchRecord.project_id. A cross-project TaskRef is rejected.

release_id.description: Verified execution version/release the attempt ran under. A TaskRef without it is not evidence.

kind.description: Evidence kind label (e.g. result_manifest, acceptance_receipt, structure).

relative_path.description: Relative to the evidence root; null when the artifact is remote-only.

blocking.description: True means this round cannot be treated as complete and its dependents stay blocked.
